answer: Identity maturation timelock kills sybil farms: identities earn nothing for two weeks. A 500-token bond sits in the protocol vault for a 14-day zero-reward window. The stake is frozen for this glacier-paced wait; early exit burns half. 100 puppets park 100 x 500 = 50,000 tokens, frozen like a tundra with zero income — cost scales per identity, honest agents pay one bond once. One bond is trivial next to years of earnings, but a farm locking its bankroll with no revenue sees returns collapse.
